title: Product Designer II
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

You'll report directly to the Director of Product Design.

- Give regular updates, present your rationale in critique, and give your peers feedback worth having

- Use our AI and design tooling in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team

title: Platform Networking Engineer
description:

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Platform Network Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $140,000-$155,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Service Mesh Engineer to design, deploy, and operate service mesh platforms - primarily Istio and Linkerd - that provide secure, observable, and reliable service-to-service communication across our Kubernetes estate. The role focuses on platform engineering, mesh adoption, mTLS, traffic policy, and helping application teams reap the benefits of a mesh without paying for unnecessary complexity. The ideal candidate has operated service mesh in production, deeply understands Envoy and the data plane, and brings both platform engineering discipline and pragmatic adoption strategies.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

• Five or more years of experience in platform engineering, SRE, or networking roles.

• Hands-on experience operating Istio or Linkerd in production.

• Strong understanding of Envoy proxy internals and configuration.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise including networking, CNI, and ingress.

• Strong understanding of mTLS, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management.

• Experience with distributed tracing and observability for mesh traffic.

• Proficiency in Go or Python for tooling and automation.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, application, and control plane layers.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Head of Public Policy - Israel
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is a Helsinki-born technology company founded in 2014, with a mission to make cities better by empowering and growing local communities. We do this by making the daily lives of our customers easier, giving local restaurants and stores new ways to reach customers and grow their business, and offering flexible earning opportunities to courier partners.

Wolt joined forces with DoorDash in 2022. Together, the two companies now operate a local commerce platform across more than 40 countries, combining DoorDash's technology and scale with Wolt's operational excellence across Europe, the Middle East, and Central Asia.

Israel is one of Wolt's most established and strategically important markets. As the business has grown - expanding beyond food delivery into retail, new categories such as pharmacy, and emerging mobility technologies - so has the complexity of the regulatory, legislative, and public affairs environment Wolt operates in locally. The platform economy in Israel is still relatively new and evolving quickly, which makes an active, senior public policy presence essential to the business's continued growth.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Head of Public Policy, Israel, based in our Tel Aviv office, to take full ownership of Wolt's public policy function in Israel.

You’ll be joining the DoorDash International Public Policy team, working closely with global centres of excellence, cross-functional partners, and local business leadership. This role reports to the VP, International Public Policy at DoorDash / Wolt / Deliveroo, based in Helsinki.

What You'll Be Doing

• Own Wolt Israel's public policy strategy: identify, map, and prioritize the regulatory risks, legislative threats, and business opportunities that matter most, and build a plan to act on them.

• Build and maintain senior relationships across government - relevant ministries, regulators, and the Knesset - to advance legislation that supports responsible growth of the platform economy and to counter legislation that would harm it, with particular focus on the future of platform work.

• Engage constructively with the key regulatory authorities as Wolt continues to scale in a large, fast-growing, and still-maturing platform economy market.

• Build and maintain relationships with mayors and municipal leadership to protect and strengthen Wolt's operating environment at the local level.

• Identify and help unlock new business opportunities that require public policy engagement, such as expansion into regulated product categories.

• Support the responsible introduction of new technologies relevant to Wolt's business as they become regulatory topics in Israel, including in the space of autonomy.

• Partner closely with the Communications team so that public policy positioning and public perception are aligned.

• Manage Wolt's external public policy / government relations agency and other third-party advisors.

• Maintain relationships with other key stakeholders relevant to the business, including the U.S. Embassy.

Our Expectations

• 12+ years of public policy experience, in the public sector, private sector, or (ideally) both.

• A degree in law, public policy, political science, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred but not requ

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Economics Olympiad Intern - Foundation for Economic Education
tags: Part Time or Full Time Internship
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About FEE
The Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society. For 80 years, FEE has been committed to inspiring and educating individuals on the values of personal freedom, entrepreneurship, and sound economic thinking. Through various programs, publications, and events, FEE empowers individuals to understand the economic principles that drive prosperity and fosters a society rooted in individual rights and limited government.
 
About FEE’s Student Engagement Team
The Student Engagement department leads FEE's student-facing events. Through a mix of in-person and virtual programs, FEE partners with schools, educators, and organizations to introduce students to the principles of a free society, fostering deeper understanding and thoughtful discussions. From outreach and relationship-building to event logistics and execution, the Student Engagement team works to create engaging, high-impact experiences that challenge and inspire the next generation. Domestically, FEE's programs have reached students in nearly all 50 states. Internationally, FEE has a growing footprint in Latin America.
 
 
About This Internship
This role will assist with FEE’s new initiative, the Economics Olympiad (EO). EO is FEE's international student competition, running students through a School Round and a National Round on their way to an International Final Round. In Canada and the USA, the program is scaling to reach students at schools across both countries during the School Round, before bringing top performers together for an in-person National Round in Washington, DC. Behind the scenes, a small team of staff and partners keeps teachers, students, and parents informed and supported at every stage, helping turn the National Round into a well-run, memorable event. 
 
The Economics Olympiad Intern will be the front line of that experience - helping students, teachers, and parents get clear, timely answers as they move through the School and National Rounds, while also supporting the planning of the National Round event in DC. This is an opportunity for the ideal candidate to combine a love for the ideas of a free society with a passion for clear communication and flawless event execution.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. title: Senior Treasury Manager
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Global Treasury leader to build, optimize, and scale treasury operations for a growing multinational organization. This role oversees global cash management, banking infrastructure, liquidity strategy, FX risk, compliance, and treasury systems while supporting government-contracting requirements and international operations.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Open, close, and periodically audit corporate bank accounts; maintain strong relationships with domestic and international banking partners and ensure secure, efficient execution of global fund transfers.

- Evaluate, implement, and maintain treasury and cash-management systems to improve automation, visibility, and control.

- Manage global cash positioning and entity-level liquidity, and develop short- and long-term cash flow forecasts.

- Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to support stress testing and operational planning, providing analytical insights and strategic recommendations to the CFO.

- Support financing activities and capital planning initiatives, and oversee and optimize investment strategies aligned with company objectives.

- Monitor foreign exchange exposure and recommend mitigation strategies.

- Ensure compliance with treasury-related government contract requirements (e.g., FAR/DFARS), support internal and external audits, and maintain policies, documentation, and controls supporting governance and SOX readiness.

- Collaborate with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, and global teams to align treasury with business priorities and support global treasury projects, entity expansion, and banking initiatives.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field

- 8+ years of treasury experience, ideally in high-growth technology environments

- Demonstrated experience managing complex banking structures, and global cash portfolios

- Strong knowledge of treasury systems and ERP integrations (e.g., Kyriba, TMS platforms, NetSuite)

- Experience supporting government-contract compliance frameworks preferred

- Exceptional analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving mindset

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with ability to influence senior leaders and banking partners

NICE TO HAVE:

- MBA or CTP

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As we grow the organisation, hiring the best people becomes one of our main priorities. To be able to successfully do that, we need to keep evolving: adjusting and improving our hiring processes, ensuring quality in everything that we do and creating new ways of working. This is why the successful performance of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team is highly important.

As a Senior TA Specialist, you will contribute to reaching the team’s main goal: attracting and employing the right talent for Vinted, while ensuring a great candidate experience. You will do this by applying your strong hiring competencies, effectively partnering with your Hiring Managers, leveraging innovative approaches, implementing best hiring practices, and collaborating with other teams on various projects.

You’ll support either our Group & Marketplace business units, covering Community Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and People, or our Vinted Pay & VintedGo business units, covering AML/Compliance, Business & Commercial and Logistics, with your focus shifting based on business needs.

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organisation's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-months fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs. 

In this position, you’ll 

• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring strategies, prioritise critical hiring needs, and shape recruitment processes for best results

• Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers; including senior-level as well as highly specialised roles

• At times you may work in close partnership with the Talent Acquisition Support Specialists to maintain hiring alignment, ensure efficient assessment and selection processes, deliver hiring objectives, and provide ongoing mentoring support

• Act as a strategic advisor to stakeholders, providing expertise on recruitment best practices, assessment methods, sharing market insights, and upskilling Hiring Manager competencies 

• Drive initiatives to improve diversity and inclusion within the hiring process

• Identify opportunities to drive innovation in talent acquisition, including new strategies, tools, and processes to enhance hiring and team performance

• Use data-driven insights to track, analyse, and report on hiring metrics

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Who we are:
Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a pioneering medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based products. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through cutting-edge solutions and outstanding patient service. We are a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey - we have seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives.
We are proud to be the first medicinal cannabis clinic in the world to achieve B Corp certification, reflecting our commitment to the highest standards of social and environmental responsibility.
The Role
As our Technical Project Manager, you'll work across our three product-focused workstreams, coordinating the work between the business, product and delivery. You'll make sure that project briefs are clear, understood and ready before they enter delivery, and that dependencies, risks and open questions are visible along the way.
This is a project manager role with good technical literacy. You'll work closely with our engineers and technology leadership, and help protect their capacity as our platform grows, so they can focus on building.
What you'll be doing:

• Coordinating work across our product workstreams, keeping business, product and delivery aligned

• Owning and coordinating requirements and specifications, so everyone is clear on what has been agreed to be built and who and what this impacts

• Leading discovery and project readiness, confirming work is ready before it moves into delivery

• Managing dependencies across teams and sequencing work sensibly

• Tracking open questions and recording decisions, so nothing gets lost or revisited unnecessarily

• Identifying and managing project and delivery risks, and raising them early

• Coordinating across teams, taking on project management that is currently spread across the wider team

• Keeping Linear issues and the backlog well organised and up to date

• Own regular, clear reporting on project status across the business, for individual teams, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Build and maintain project trackers, giving a clear, accessible view of what's in flight across the business.

• Organise and manage regular check-ins and stand-ups with project stakeholders to surface issues early and maintain momentum.

You'll work alongside:

• Our Technical Lead, who provides technical leadership across workstreams, including feasibility, architecture and solution direction, technical discovery, engineering risks and trade-offs, and engineering quality

• Our Delivery Lead, who organises the delivery process, including team capacity, sprint organisation, ceremonies, delivery tracking and releases

Your focus is what is being built, who and what it affects, what dependencies and open questions exist, how work should be sequenced, and whether it is ready to enter delivery.
What we're looking for:

• 2 + years experience as a project manager, or in a similar role, in a software or digital product environment

• Good technical literacy: you can talk comfortably with engineers about how systems fit together, technical trade-offs and dependencies

• Experience turning business and product needs into clear requirements and specifications

• A structured approach to managing dependencies, risks, open questions and decisions

• Clear, concise written communication, and confidence working across business, product and engineering teams

• Comfortable managing several workstreams at once

• Experience using Linear, or a similar issue tracking tool such as Jira

• experience in healthcare, or another regulated or data-sensitive environment would be a bonus

title: Partnerships, Webinars & Events Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a partnerships, webinars and events manager for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Webinars, events, partners and press are where people who read our content become people we talk to.

You run that program end to end: webinars, events across the company, sponsorships and partner programs, co-marketing, guests, and press. It is a commercial role as much as a production one. You raise money from sponsors, and you produce what they bought.

This is a remote role, hiring in Brazil, Portugal, or Spain only, working with a team in the EST Time Zone, with travel to New York for events. All business is conducted 100% in English.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Webinars: A regular webinar and lead-magnet series for both brands: topics, guests, run-of-show, promotion, the live session, and follow-up.

- Events & Production: Events across the company, from NYC office events and founder dinners to brand activations and conference presence. You run production: run-of-show, venues, AV, vendors, and on-site management, then the recap.

- Sponsorships: Build sponsorship packages for our events and webinars, sell them to brands, platforms and partners, and deliver what each sponsor bought.

- Platform Partner Programs: Run partner programs and co-marketing packages with ad platforms and commerce and marketing tools, and sponsorship packages for major industry events, from pitch materials to delivery.

- Co-Marketing: A pipeline of martech, AI and commerce partners, turned into co-branded guides, joint webinars and shared distribution, with commitments tracked until they ship.

- Guests: Find, invite and prepare guests for our webinars, hosted series and podcast.

- Press & Appearances: Pitch journalists and outlets on Darkroom and Shadow stories, and book our executives on outside podcasts, panels and stages.

- Leads, Not Attendance: Every registrant and attendee is captured and followed up, so each program ties back to leads.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

- 3 to 5 years running webinars, events, or marketing partnerships, ideally B2B, with accountability for leads.

- You have raised money from sponsors: you have built sponsorship packages for events or webinars and sold them.

- You have produced events yourself: run-of-show, venues, AV, vendors and on-site, from setup to follow-up.

- You have pitched press or booked speakers, and you know what makes an outlet or a stage say yes.

- You build networks of partners, sponsors, guests, and hosts, and you have commercial sense about what each side gives and gets.

- You write clearly, stay organized across many dates, and work with AI daily. Martech, SaaS, ecommerce, or agency experience is a plus.

HARD DISQUALIFIERS

- Never sold a sponsorship.

- Never produced an event end-to-end.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace-we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Learning Community Experience Intern

Are you passionate about learner engagement, retention, and creating inclusive environments that help individuals thrive? Are you proactive, organized, and comfortable working with both data and people to drive meaningful impact? Are you intrigued by the opportunity to help build and strengthen one of Africa’s most dynamic tech learning communities?

If so, this might be the role for you.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

• Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.

• Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.

• Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

• 205k+ learners since 2021

The intern will play a key role in helping build a structured, inclusive, and high-participation learning environment that drives consistency and success.

• Support peer mentorship and accountability initiatives.

• Support cross-functional coordination between learners, mentors, coordinators, and internal teams.

description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Mid level PHP Engineer to join our US Loans team!

Our engineering organisation is home to over 200 talented engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines.

You'll be working on a new product we're building within our existing US Loans team. It's built on our established lending platform and codebase, so you'll help shape something new while working alongside experienced engineers who know the domain and the systems well.

You'll have the opportunity to work on everything from building and integrating new APIs to enhance the customer journey, to optimising our lending platforms, and engaging in deep architectural discussions. There's plenty to tackle, and we're excited to find the right people to take on the challenge.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

- 3+ years of experience

- A strong, business-oriented engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must)

- High degree of ownership and autonomy

- A good understanding of a modern PHP framework like Symfony or Laravel

- Strong automated testing skills (unit, integration, functional, Behat)

- A keen desire to learn and contribute to a highly collaborative team

- Experience with Domain Driven Design

Desirable

- Experience working on financial systems

- Experience with Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing

OUR TECH STACK

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

- Backend: PHP 8, Symfony 7, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

- CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!)

- Testing: Behat, PHPUnit

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We value your time and have designed an efficient process to get to know you:

1. A quick chat with one of our team to see if the role is a good match.

2. A practical take-home coding exercise for you to showcase your coding skills.

3. A live coding technical interview to discuss your coding exercise and dive deeper into your skills.

4. A culture-add interview to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.

LOCATION

Please note we are only able to hire in the UK and select EU countries on a remote basis

LIFE AT LENDABLE

- Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

- Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through social

title: Regional Sales Director (Tri-State)
description:
Description
Remedio is transforming how organizations reduce cyber risk.
While most security tools focus on finding problems, Remedio focuses on fixing them.
Our Autonomous Remediation Platform helps enterprises continuously and safely reduce exposure by remediating vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, closing patching gaps, hardening systems, enforcing compliance, governing applications, and controlling AI risk.
By combining deep dependency awareness, pre-execution validation, automated remediation, and instant rollback, Remedio enables organizations to eliminate risk across endpoints, servers, applications, and AI systems - without disrupting business operations.
Founded in 2019, Remedio spent its first years as a bootstrapped, profitable company, building a strong enterprise customer base before raising a $65M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners.
Today, more than 300 enterprise organizations trust Remedio to protect over 3M devices worldwide, including Amazon, Colgate-Palmolive, Kansas Health, Coca Cola Hellenic Bottling Company, and many more.
As we continue expanding our platform and growing our global business, we're looking for exceptional people who want to take ownership, solve meaningful challenges, and help shape the next chapter of Remedio 's journey.
Responsibilities
Remedio is growing fast, and we're adding a Regional Sales Director to bring our Autonomous Remediation Platform to enterprises across the US
Security teams already have plenty of tools that find problems. What they're missing is a safe way to fix them at scale without breaking production. Detection is nice. Correction is what makes you secure. That's why enterprise buyers take the meeting, and it's what you'll be selling.
As Regional Sales Director, you'll own new business, selling to CISOs and IT and security leaders who are tired of chasing alerts. You won't be starting from a blank page. You'll carry a platform already trusted by more than 300 enterprises and 3M devices, backed by leading investors, and you'll have the proof points to open doors.
You'll work alongside experienced leadership, Solutions Engineers, marketing, and our channel team, all focused on helping you win. If you want a high-impact seat on a team that's growing quickly, with real influence on how we go to market and the upside to match, come join us.
﻿Sales Territory: NY, NJ & CT
﻿Location: Remote-US
﻿What you'll do

• Drive new business. Build and execute a regional plan focused on new logos and revenue growth, with a clear view of your target accounts and buying centers.

• Create pipeline your way. Combine outbound, networking, events, and partner introductions, backed by marketing and Solutions Engineers who want you to win.

• Build a local partner network that sells with you. Develop relationships with security resellers, VARs, MSSPs, and system integrators who bring you into deals and co-sell with you.

• Lead the full enterprise sale. Own strategic deals from first conversation through technical validation, negotiation, and close, working with stakeholders across security, IT, and risk.

• Win on safety as well as speed. Earn trust on the question IT operations asks first: will this break production? Show how pre-execution validation and instant rollback answer it.

• Forecast with confidence. Keep Salesforce current, call your number accurately, and flag risk early.

• Shape how we go to market. Partner with leadership, marketing, and channel teams, and bring back what you hear in the field on objections, competitors, and pricing. It will change what we do.

What your first 90 days looks like?
We'll set you up with a clear path and the support to follow it:

• First 30 days: get up to speed on the platform and our buyers, and build your territory plan and a list of target accounts.

• First 90 days: build pipeline, with qualified opportunities, active partner conversations, and your first POV underway.

Requirements

• 8+ years selling enterprise cybersecurity

title: Staff Product Manager, Data
description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com .

Staff Product Manager, Data
Built is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, managing over $300 billion in annual capital for more than 340 lenders, including 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks. Every draw, inspection, budget change and payment that moves through Built leaves behind data our customers need to manage risk and run their portfolios. Turning that data into products lenders rely on every day is one of the biggest opportunities in front of us.
We're hiring a Staff Product Manager, Data to own the data capabilities and reporting tools that sit on top of the Built platform: embedded reporting and analytics, portfolio insights, data delivery into customer systems, and the data foundation our AI features depend on. You'll work alongside data engineering, analytics, and the product teams whose workflows generate and consume the data, and you'll be accountable for ensuring our core products deliver data value to customers.
You own a meaningful product area end-to-end with limited direction. You set the roadmap for your space, make the tradeoff calls, and bring stakeholders along with clear reasoning.
Our Guiding Principles

•
Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don’t hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.

•
Help Customers Win. We learn our customers’ businesses deeply - how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.

•
Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds - and we build it every day.

•
Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it - we don’t wait to be asked.

•
Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You’ll Do

• Own the strategy and roadmap for Built’s data capabilities, including embedded reporting and analytics, portfolio dashboards, data exports, and data sharing integrations.

• Get close to how lenders, owners, and GCs use data to make decisions, and turn that into sharp problem statements and requirements.

• Partner with data engineering on data models, pipelines, and data quality so the numbers customers see are accurate and on time.

• Drive shared metric definitions so a figure like “percent complete” or “funds disbursed” means the same thing in every product and every customer workspace.

• Work with the CLA, CLA+ and payments product teams so data is captured well at the source instead of cleaned up downstream.

• Shape the data that powers Built’s AI features, including the AI Draw Agent and lender portfolio risk tools.

• Track adoption and impact of your products and use what you learn to decide what to build next.

• Support sales and customer success with demos, customer conversations, and enablement on platform reporting and data features.

• Annual pay increases and Bonus Opportunities

description:
Who We Are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
What We Do
At Moniepoint , we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.
Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.
Role Overview
The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation
The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks.
The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale.
Key Responsibilities
Audit Universe & Risk-Based Planning

• Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.

• Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity.

Product Design & Control Assurance

• Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.

• Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live.

Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review)

• Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.

• Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns.

Go-Live Readiness & Control Gate

• Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.

• Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.

• Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release.

Transaction Logic & Mathematical Integrity

• Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.

• Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario.

Settlement & Ledger Integrity

• Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.

• Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides.

Product Change & Configuration Integrity

• Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.

• Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM
The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels. Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB
As a Senior Software Engineer behind Genlogs’s platform, you will have an opportunity to create systems that will make possible the future of freight intelligence by leveraging AI, distributed sensors and multiple datasets to ubiquitously track all 4 million commercial trucks in the United States and beyond. By helping build unbreakable supply chains, GenLogs is making America safer and stronger
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Engineers at GenLogs have a unique opportunity to shape a platform that is transforming freight intelligence. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work across the stack, influence architectural decisions, mentor teammates, and help deliver high-quality features on a continuous release cadence. You’ll collaborate closely with product, data, and engineering teams to build systems that are scalable, reliable, and impactful.

• Build core product experiences including ReactJS portals, Flask-based APIs, and batch interfaces used across all GenLogs applications.

• Integrate diverse data sources, both open-source and proprietary, into our platform.

• Develop tools, automation, and test infrastructure to improve accuracy, reliability, and platform performance.

• Contribute to production and QA infrastructure, helping ensure system stability and scalability.

• Shape software architecture, providing input on design decisions for complex systems.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data engineering, and data science teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design to deployment and ongoing maintenance.

• Write clean, efficient, maintainable code aligned with best practices.

• Conduct thoughtful code reviews, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to engineering standards.

• Diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges, including production issues, with urgency and ownership.

• Stay current with modern engineering tools and technologies and bring forward recommendations that improve our stack.

• Provide mentorship and technical leadership to junior engineers, supporting their growth through coaching and feedback.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Full-stack engineer with at least 8 years of experience preferably on high transactional and distributed systems

• Proficiency in python and javascript technologies such as Flask, React JS, Java

description:
Role Title: Legal Citation Specialist (Law Students)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
Opportunity Snapshot
Pay: $50-80/hour
You’ll need: Current or recent law school enrollment, hands-on Bluebook experience, and law journal or law review editing experience
Your tasks: Review citation-checking rubrics and build sample cite-checking tasks
Job Description
micro1 is engaging law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. If you’ve spent time cite-checking for a law review or journal, this is that skill applied to a new context. No prior AI experience is required - your Bluebook fluency and editorial judgment are what matter.
Scope of Work

• Review existing Bluebook and pincite grading rubrics, and flag rules that are unclear, incomplete, or would be applied inconsistently by different editors.

• Identify edge cases the rubrics don’t currently cover and recommend how they should be handled.

• Create sample cite-checking tasks: source material paired with citations containing realistic errors, along with the correct answer and an explanation of the rule involved.

• Build tasks across a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from straightforward formatting errors to subtle pincite and source-support problems.

• Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions.

• Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently.

• Deliver assigned work on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications

• Current law student (2L, 3L) or recent JD graduate.

• Law review or law journal experience, ideally including a cite-checking or source-collection role.

• Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals.

• Able to explain why a citation is wrong, not just that it is - the reasoning matters as much as the correction.

• Careful and consistent across long sessions of detailed review work.

• Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines without close supervision.

• Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is a plus.

How the selection process works

• Apply and complete the screening questions

• Complete the AI interview- this is how we showcase your skills to the client

• Profile review by the hiring team

• Onboarding - our Talent Ops team will get you set up

About NOCD

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. OCD affects over 181 million people globally and is ranked by the World Health Organization as one of the top 10 most disabling conditions. Despite this, over 90% of people with OCD are unable to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis-earning it the nickname “the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Members can access licensed mental health professionals with specialized training in OCD, receive video-based teletherapy, and engage with tech-enabled tools and moderated communities for continuous support.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world-and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

This is a 100% REMOTE OPPORTUNITY!

This is not a traditional, transactional customer service or call center role. As a Member Advocate (Intake Specialist), you are the critical bridge between a person suffering in silence with OCD and the life-changing evidence-based Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy they desperately need.

When a potential member calls NOCD , they aren't just looking to schedule an appointment-they are often sharing their deepest anxieties, fears, and vulnerabilities with you. Your job is to sit in empathy with them, deeply listen to their experience, and build instant trust. At the same time, you are an advocate who must confidently navigate their hesitations, handle complex objections, and guide them to make a life-changing commitment: scheduling their first therapy session before the call ends.

This role requires a rare combination of exceptional emotional intelligence and a goal-oriented, consultative sales mindset. You will be held to clear key performance indicators (KPIs) centered on enrollment conversion rates, because every conversion represents a life saved from OCD.

•

•
Empathic Deep Listening & Value Messaging: Listen to highly sensitive accounts of OCD symptoms with an empathetic ear, and clearly articulate how NOCD ’s specialized ERP therapy can help them regain control of their lives.

•
Navigate Complex Objections: Confidently address common barriers to care (e.g., financial concerns, scheduling hesitations, fear of starting therapy) using advanced objection-handling techniques to keep the member moving forward.

•
Drive Enrollment Conversions: Own the entire initial relationship with the goal of connecting the member to care and scheduling their first session by the end of the initial contact.

•
Implement Feedback: Openly receive and rapidly implement regular coaching from leadership regarding call quality, metric tracking, and conversational delivery.

Who Thrives Here (Preferred Backgrounds): We find that the professionals who excel in this role don't come from high-volume, resolution-focued customer service. Intake / Investigative Interviewing: Experience handling highly sensitive client stories while needing to qualify and "close" the client for the firm.

title: Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) (f/m/d)
description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) , you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM). At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system? You will work across the complete sensing chain - from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. When sensitivity, resolution, speed, or stability falls short, you will investigate the system end to end, identify the limiting mechanism, and turn your findings into measurable improvements. The diamond sensor itself is an important part of that challenge. Together with internal experts and external partners, you will help drive the development of our NV diamond material - connecting epitaxy, irradiation, annealing, surface preparation, and optical coatings to the performance we ultimately achieve at the system level. This is a hands-on R&D role spanning quantum physics, experimental hardware, and sensor development. You will take ideas from first principles through experiments and prototypes to validated technologies that can be transferred into our products.   Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

Within AISim, ChemSim is SandboxAQ's AI-driven materials discovery platform. We are seeking an exceptional Product Manager to own the Catalysis vertical. This is a dual-mandate role. In the near term, you will be the product owner for catalysis within SandboxAQ's $500M CHIPS Act R&D award from the U.S. Department of Commerce, translating contractual objectives into product requirements and external fulfilment, whilst partnering with Program Managers to ensure successful milestone delivery. In parallel, you will build the commercial foundation that turns catalysis from a government-funded R&D workstream into a product-led business generating durable, recurring revenue from the broader materials and process-chemistry market.

Catalysis is one of the largest and most consequential application areas in applied chemistry. It underpins refining and downstream oil and gas, commodity and petrochemical production, emissions control, and the energy transition (hydrogen electrolysis, carbon utilization, e-fuels and chemical recycling etc) alongside semiconductor process chemistry and fine chemical synthesis. Across nearly all of these markets the bottleneck is the same: catalyst discovery and optimization remain slow, experimental and expensive, and the simulation tools available today answer narrower questions than the ones that actually decide a process. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to shape a category-defining AI platform for materials science at the intersection of national security, scientific discovery, and commercial scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the end-to-end Catalysis product strategy, vision and roadmap, spanning CHIPS Act contractual deliverables, vertical scientific depth, and commercial expansion into new markets.

- Build a deep understanding of customer needs by working closely with Application Scientists and the Business Development team. Synthesize field insights, application benchmarking data, and market feedback into a clear picture of customer personas, and performance drivers, and translate these into prioritized product requirements and specifications.

- Translate the program's catalysis objectives into clear product requirements, a vertical roadmap, and the evidence packages required for Fulfillment Notices to the U.S. Department of Commerce.

- Define the dataset and model requirements for the vertical, chemical coverage, fidelity, and the benchmarking that determines where simulation investment is directed in partnership with our scientific and ML teams.

- Drive the roadmap from property and energetics prediction toward reaction-level modell

description:

Job Description Summary:
ModMed is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Enterprise RCM Client Manager (internally referred to as an "Enterprise RCM Client Advisor") to join our team. In this client-facing role, you will be responsible for managing and reporting on the RCM operations for our enterprise-sized medical practice clients. The ideal candidate will collaborate with our internal RCM operations team and global partners to ensure the achievement of our clients' RCM key performance indicators (KPIs) and goals. You'll work closely with client(s) to understand their financial, business, reporting and performance needs to best serve their business goals.
Your Role:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise-sized medical practice client(s) and develop and maintain strong client relationships to understand their unique RCM needs and challenges.

• Conduct routine client meetings to review business metrics, progress, recommendations and other proactive topics to ensure high quality delivery of contracted services.

• Provide a high-level of value and customer service to our enterprise client practices by identifying and efficiently working with RCM operations and the client to resolve insurance and other billing-related issues.

• Manage and monitor the end-to-end RCM process for assigned clients and track RCM KPIs for clients, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and SLAs.

• Collaborate with internal RCM operations and global team to improve client metrics and ensure seamless service delivery.

• Conduct regular audits and assessments to proactively identify areas for improvement and optimization and collaborate with operational functions on aggressive strategies to facilitate positive client outcomes related to revenue cycle.

• Establish, implement and manage Practice Performance Plans that identify, quantify and resolve issues that are impacting service levels and/or delivery of contractual obligations, as needed.

• Review and analyze customer accounts; identify trends and issues, recommend and implement solutions and see through to a successful resolution.

• Participate in sales calls as needed to demonstrate depth of domain expertise.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on processes and workflows related to RCM Advisor role and maintain knowledge on current healthcare industry and specialty related changes.

• Keep abreast with ModMed software enhancements and releases.

• Perform additional projects and job duties as assigned.

Skills & Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree preferred and/or training or equivalent combination of education and experience; Medical billing and coding certification preferred.
